evidence: We center the Trans, Non-Binary, and Gender Nonconforming (TGNC) and queer communities, offering a safe, joyful space to gather, share art, and enjoy coffee.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, abilities, and identities, including LGBTQ+ individuals.
We are the Lavender Library, a volunteer-run LGBTQ+ library and community hub in Sacramento.
We are the North County LGBTQ Resource Center, a 501(c)3 nonprofit dedicated to supporting and empowering the lesbian, gay, transgender, bisexual, and questioning community in North County San Diego.
